summary: Frontend regression pass after KES-standard-currency refactor + compare-with-body feature. All 7 review-request scenarios PASS. (1) Buyer registration (kes_test_ttryuv@test.com) succeeded end-to-end from welcome→Create Account→gender+DOB→onboarding/measurements with no crash. (2) Seller registration via the 'Sell on Oromona' footer link (register-seller-link) succeeded — landed in seller portal (KES Atelier Studios, Nairobi, Kenya) with 'KSh 0' revenue formatting confirming KES default. (3) Buyer login (buyer@aurafit.com) header pill shows KES. (4) Currency sheet lists Kenyan Shilling FIRST; scrolls DOWN to EGP (Egyptian Pound) and back UP to KES smoothly — previous 'refuses to scroll' bug is fixed by the bounded listBox maxHeight=420. (5) Currency round-trip KES→USD (prices repaint with $) → KES completed; buyer left on KES. (6) Compare-with-my-body works: waist='Your waist: 81cm — this size runs 5cm smaller', hips='Your hips: 98cm — this size runs 2cm smaller', rise=NO compare line (no body value; hint still shows 'Rise — Crotch seam to top of waistband'). (7) Unit toggle to IN correctly converts: 'Your waist: 31.9" — this size runs 2" smaller'. Fit preview banner ('Very tight across the waist (-5.0cm)', score 79) + narration chips (Very Tight Waist, Snug Hips) + size chips + buy button all render unaffected. No React Native red screens; only benign 'shadow*/pointerEvents deprecated' RN-web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: CurrencyPill.tsx default testID='currency-pill' but Discover header passes testID='discover-currency-pill' — task spec referenced the generic id; not a bug, just noting the testID naming diverges from the review-request text (options are e.g. discover-currency-pill-option-KES).
auth.tsx registerBuyer/registerSeller correctly hardcode preferred_currency='KES' via STANDARD_CURRENCY constant — no device-locale coupling remains.
GarmentMeasureGuide.tsx compareText prop cleanly conditional on activeKey; hint still renders when compareText is null (rise case) — matches spec.
seed_data_creation: Two throwaway test accounts created (buyer kes_test_ttryuv@test.com, seller kes_seller_l07q7p@test.com) — per review-request 'Clean up not needed'.

Item size chips are 'item-size-<LABEL>' (not 'item-size-chip-<LABEL>'). Buyer left with preferred_currency=KES as required.
